latest_audit_findings: Exact B1.11 MOD_meteo.f90 member reconstructed from the release archive; SHA-256 99fbf7ad4d90f71cc86012e8e1c9970ef4ca40ea879f0f0622a02a0c33be4c9f.
B1.11 Rutter uses piecewise constant canopy input/output fluxes with internal fill and dry event times. It does not use fimin or the SWAP 4.2.0 exponential storage equation.
The current source-window integrator resolves B1.11-style process events internally and returns interval-average fluxes; event transitions do not command Richards substeps.

Constant surface irrigation now passes the B1.11 ISUA=0 intercepted and ISUA/=0 rain-only partitions in local process and FMR production tests. The production test uses a low irrigation rate of 0.01 cm/day with 0.2 cm rainfall per source window.

Higher tested irrigation throughfall combinations reached the Reference Richards error "HeadCalc: dynamic head regime omitted surface-head derivative". Those high-forcing combinations remain outside this qualification pending the separately owned top-boundary/Jacobian issue.

Targeted INT13 run 37276517425 and PPA-WU01 owner run 37276517357 both passed on exact candidate commit 6f6eba2241b662cf0d3c1126bd21a63845b6ee41; the earlier INT13 run 37271615834 qualifies only the rain-only candidate.
next_action: Complete canonical review and the required canonical branch qualification before integration. Any integration must retain the exact tested low-rate constant surface-irrigation envelope; qualify the separate Reference Richards derivative repair before extending the envelope.
dependency_surface: SWINTER=0/1/2, Black and Boesten preservation interfaces
scope_limitations: The persisted irrigation envelope is constant surface irrigation at the tested low-rate vector (0.01 cm/day) with 0.2 cm rainfall per source window, both ISUA partitions, and constant forcing per immutable source window.
Higher throughfall combinations trigger the separately owned Reference Richards error 'HeadCalc: dynamic head regime omitted surface-head derivative' and remain out of scope.
Irrigation scheduling, sprinkling, Snow, Black/Boesten with Rutter, macropore, RFM/surface-water combinations and unsupported solver profiles remain out of scope.
SWINTER=3 remains unadmitted pending canonical integration.
